barRaise.topFinding: The stranded v0.7.x pass is now 14 days old and the pile grew again, but the sharper find this run is what happens when its blocked sibling finally lands. scripts/sync-audit-dashboard.ps1 (untracked, written 2026-07-10 to close the chronic audit-pointer finding) unconditionally Remove-Item -Force's .git/index.lock and .git/HEAD.lock in YesAndEverything at lines 104-107, with no live-process check and no git-guard.ps1 dot-source. That is the exact pattern this project's CLAUDE.md and the portfolio git-safety standard forbid, aimed at the busiest repo on the FUSE mount: YaE takes writes from every per-project routine, the hourly queue drain, and the 30-minute usage refresh. Wiring it as written trades a stale dashboard pointer for NUL-corrupted YaE git state. Everything else holds: all five hard rules pass, so no BLOCK, and the 139 tests across 21 files run green in the dirty tree, so the unshipped work is verified-correct rather than merely unfinished. Health slips 88 to 85 entirely on machinery findings, not app regressions; release-sync-01 stays HIGH at 3 runs and audit-loop-integrity-01 is chronic at 6.
